name: Mythical Match: A Yokai Love Story
source:
One man's horror story can be someone else's meet cute.

Tomomi, a young man living in 19th century Japan, stumbles upon an injuried ushi-oni, a yokai known for it's fearsome appearance, whitout realizing that this fateful encounter will change his life forever.

[From [url=https://jessicathomson.itch.io/mythical-match]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个人的恐怖故事可能是别人的可爱故事。

生活在19世纪日本的年轻人智美偶然发现了一只受伤的牛鬼（一种以其可怕的外表而闻名的妖怪），却没有意识到这次命运般的邂逅将永远改变他的生活。

[来自[url=https://jessicathomson.itch.io/mythical-match]itch.io[/url]]
